headword.verification_note: 可识别为专有名词Andrew，未确认其为具有普通词义的正式马来语词条。保留输入的小写键和word值；实际人名通常首字母大写。IPA为常见英语读音，排名沿用输入。

morphology.pattern_note: 整个人名作为独立单位记忆，不进行马来语词缀拆分；英语通常有两个音节，重音在首音节。历史相关名字不属于马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: Andrew，通常音译为“安德鲁”：英语中常见的男性名字。
senses.en_definition: Andrew: a traditionally masculine given name used in English.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang lazim digunakan sebagai nama peribadi lelaki dalam bahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 词性在本结构中归入noun，具体属于专有名词。马来语句子保留Andrew，不把其历史含义译作人物性格。中文译名须尊重本人惯用形式。以下为称呼和句法组合示例，并非经统计确认的高频搭配。[名字来源](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Andrew)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Encik Andrew akan membentangkan laporan kemajuan projek pada mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 安德鲁先生将在明天的会议上汇报项目进展。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Andrew will present the project progress report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Andrew dah sampai kat lobi ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Andrew sudah tiba di lobi?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Andrew arrived in the lobby yet?

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Andrew dah sampai kat lobi ke? Aku nak turun sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Andrew sudah tiba di lobi? Saya hendak turun sekarang.
messages.zh: 安德鲁到大厅了吗？我现在准备下去。
messages.en: Has Andrew arrived in the lobby? I'm about to head down.

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tunggu kat depan lif je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah tiba dan sedang menunggu di hadapan lif.
messages.zh: 到了，他就在电梯前面等着。
messages.en: Yes, he's here. He's waiting right by the lift.

etymology.historical_story: Andrew reached English through French forms associated with Latin Andreas and Greek Andreas. The Greek name is related to words for a man or manliness. Saint Andrew's longstanding association with Scotland gives the name a cultural history beyond its linguistic roots. In contemporary use, however, Andrew identifies a person rather than describing that person's courage or character. [Source: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Andrew).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到/ˈæn.druː/，联想到“安德鲁”这位具体的人；大写A提醒你这是名字。不要拆成and加其他片段来猜马来语词义。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 初次或正式接触时，可按对方身份使用Encik Andrew或适用职衔；熟悉后依对方偏好直接称Andrew。
